newsitem.title: USA: NYC Water Auth. still aims for Tuesday bond sale.
newsitem.headline: NYC Water Auth. still aims for Tuesday bond sale.

text.p: New York City Municipal Water Finance Authority on Thursday said it still was planning to sell about $635 million of bonds on Tuesday, though it was carefully watching the timing of a possible competing sale.

The Water Authority official, who declined to be named, said: "We'll try to stay out of each other's way as much as we can," referring to the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey, which wants to sell $930 million of bonds on Friday.

That sale has been delayed several times, first due to the project's complexity, and then because documents had to be rewritten after it proved economical to get insurance for the entire offering, a Lehman Brothers official said, noting no definite decision had been made on the sale's timing.

Lehman is the lead underwriter, and because the sales documents were not delivered to institutional buyers until Monday, the sales date hinges on when the firms complete their approval process, explained Jim Taylor, a senior vice president, at Lehman.
